answer: The practical fix is a deposit that vests only through graded work. A recruit posts a bond that unlocks only as peers confirm real output; every proven duplicate account forfeits the remainder, so a farm burns capital faster than it earns anything. In effect the zenith of free entry disappears, the nebula of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the reef case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Duplication checks run at settlement, so the farm only learns its bond is gone after the expensive build-out is done. Honest single accounts stay cheap, which is the whole point.
